ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Spicy Meal uses your precise location while you are choosing a delivery point, so your pin lands at the right door for the driver. You can always move the pin yourself, and your location is never used in the background.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Spicy Meal does not request motion or fitness data. This description is required because the location library bundled in the app links Apple's motion framework, which Spicy Meal never calls.
